maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from recurring cash-in-transit, ATM and cash management services, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly banks, retailers and commercial businesses paying for armored transport, ATM services and cash management; government is minor.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own cash management and ATM services and subscriptions, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Secure cash transport, smart safes and ATM management are embedded in operations; switching means downtime, security risk and hardware changes.
